🐉 Spot the Difference! Can You Find Them All?
At first glance, all the dragons look exactly the same..
.
But look a little closer, and you'll find 3 dragons that
are different! 👀 Can you spot all three? Take on this
tricky challenge! 🔎✨

💬 How to Participate
1. Find the 3 different dragons in the image and
comment with their locations.
2. Don't forget to include your Server ID and In-Game
Name!

🎁 Event Rewards
10 lucky Lords will each win a $4.99 Gold Block gift!

📅 Event Period: October 19–26
🎁 Winner Announcement: October 29

💡 Hint: The secret is hidden in the little dragons'
noses!
Put your sharp eyes to the test and spot all three!
